invariants.rationale: Typically, rollbackInstantTime identifies the instant to be rolled back and should not be null.
A rollback operation generally requires a valid commitInstant to specify what is being rolled back.
The context is required for execution of engine tasks associated with rollback, so it is expected to be non-null.
If deleteInstants is true, a valid commitInstant is likely necessary to indicate which instant to delete.
rollbackInstantTime is likely a timestamp or identifier and should not be an empty string.
